message:
Fixed. `postSlug("Crème brûlée recipes")` now returns `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including the accented-letters test that was failing.

The change is in `src/blog/slug.js`. The vendored `slugify` strips every character outside `a-z0-9`, so it deleted `è` and `û` instead of mapping them to `e` and `u`. The fix decomposes the title with Unicode NFD normalization and removes the combining accent marks before calling the vendor function. I left `vendor/` untouched.

`src/shop/product-url.js` calls the same vendored `slugify` directly, so product URLs with accented names will still lose those letters. You didn't ask for that to change, so I left it alone. If you want it fixed too, it would need the same normalization step.
